reviews.author: Monette DeBaun Stransom
reviews.text: I adore OCP in Bishop Arts!  Easy parking, a warm welcome when you walk in the door, always enough equipment, and knowledgeable, challenging instructors.  I started Pilates this past year, and a class at OCP has always made me feel encouraged and successful.

reviews.author: Danna Pyke
reviews.text: Daisy is such an excellent Pilates instructor. I love the flow of her classes and she’s delightful. Oak Cliff Pilates is fun and a great workout!

reviews.author: Caitlin P
reviews.text: One of my favorite classes in Dallas. Specifically the Uptown location. These classes take classic reformer Pilates to a good extreme. I always leave feeling like I had a real workout. Victorias classes will have you leaving with washboard abs, her classes are the best.

reviews.author: Claire Myers
reviews.text: I've been suffering from chronic back pain for years and years. Took two classes this week and my pain is seriously gone! I loved the slow and focused movement of class. It was the exact kind of restorative and energizing movement my body was needing to feel better! I am hooked! Definitely a studio that is more true to classic pilates versus the upbeat fast paced classes you see at other studios! I highly recommend! Just got my membership!

reviews.author: Michelle Webb
reviews.text: A magnificent experience in a place where the instructors are incredible 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

reviews.author: LuxeGiving LLC
reviews.text: I had the opportunity to purchase an 3 classes for $25 pass. It was my first experience to reformer Pilates. I did have a great experience. I will definitely come back. The class in the middle of the day was perfect.

reviews.author: Bree Tinto
reviews.text: Awesome place! Great instructors and location! So fun and can’t wait to take another class here!

reviews.author: Emily M
reviews.text: I love this studio! It’s usually pretty easy to sign up for classes. The studio is super clean and everyone is friendly. Latoisha is awesome!

reviews.author: Angela Romei
reviews.text: I was in Dallas for two weeks on business. Staying in uptown. And this studio was such a great find! If you do Pilates regularly, you’ll find most of their classes to be pretty fast paced. I loved the arms, abs and glute class for a good & fast workout. I really appreciated instructor, Alyson Wells… out of the 6 classes I took, she appeared to be their only classically trained instructor - if that’s important to you.

reviews.author: Christy Curtis
reviews.text:
Alyson, our Certified Pilates Instructor, was fantastic! It is not often, in this day & age, that I can find a space that has actual Certified instructors that teach the Methods of Joseph Pilates. Alyson is a rare gem in this new “pop up” Pilates Studio world we live in now.
I will most certainly be back to take another class from her! Strongly recommend taking her class here. You will not be disappointed! 10/10!

reviews.author: Kelly S
reviews.text: I have been taking classes regularly at the Lower Greenville location since they opened end of last year. I love how clean and bright the studio always is, the variety of class times and the knowledgeable instructors. I have taken classes with a number of different instructors and can appreciate how each one cues moves in their own way, but Alyson W is definitely my favorite. I will rearrange my class times when I see her on the schedule. I especially appreciate how cognizant she is of adjusting her planned class flow to the individual students in each class.  Whether its due to injury, ability, or personal preferences for what we focus on that day in class (I always ask for balance work) she ensures we get a good total body workout that fits with our goals and does not have us changing springs and equipment after every move making the class more efficient. Overall, I really enjoy the studio as a whole and recommend it to everyone!

reviews.author: Miranda Lenning
reviews.text:
I love Oak Cliff Pilates! I go everyday and take advantage of the diverse group of motivating instructors. It really is among the best studios I’ve ever practiced at. Highly recommend everyone to spend some time there! Just finished  class with Z and it was so good and motivating!

Additionally, I took Allyson Wells’ jump board class today, and it was amazing. She was challenging while being organized and motivating. Her choreographed approach is unmatched. The music was so fun! It was my favorite class all week. Thank you OCP for giving us these beautiful instructors who make our day ❤️

reviews.author: Renn Padgett
reviews.text: This was my first pilates class ever. It was tough but I was able to keep up with the modifications Amanda give with each instruction. I really felt the burn of the workout and am feeling a tad sore after. Overall, I really enjoyed this experience.

reviews.author: Christina Neuhoff
reviews.text: I love this place I have been going to classes here for the last 3 months and can’t believe the difference the classes have made in my life. My muscle tone, posture and balance has undergone a significant change. I was really nervous to try this but all of the instructors that I have had are extremely patient and thorough. There are a variety of classes to choose from. As a 60 year old starting a new work out routine can be intimidating but this studio has a variety of ages and stages. I am hooked.

reviews.author: Brittany Nickolyn
reviews.text: This is the best pilates studio in Dallas...hands down. Incredibly culture, classes, and instructors.

reviews.author: Rocio Alcala
reviews.text: The instructors are all great. Each class is tailored differently such as the instructor but they’re always there to help you. I enjoy going and taking different classes. The location is great and the people there are friendly and kind. I’ve been going for now 2 years and I can’t see myself anywhere else taking Pilates. It’s become my home away from home.

reviews.author: Toni Young
reviews.text: Daisy was awesome! Very patient, kind and gave clear instructions. The class had me SWEATING!!!! Highly recommend classical AF with Daisy

reviews.author: Cierra Scott
reviews.text: Alyson has been the best! I was nervous at first since I have never taken a Pilates class. She was very encouraging & patient. Alyson made sure I didn’t compare myself to the more tenured students while still giving me the extra support needed for a newcomer. 🫶🏽Her corrections were gentle & easy to understand. I will be waking up @5am just to take one of her classes a week!

reviews.author: Tanner Rottman
reviews.text: I had never done Pilates before and went to a class here. Charley was an excellent instructor and great at teaching beginners what to do. The class in general was fantastic and the equipment and overall aesthetic was perfect.

reviews.author: Miranda Foster
reviews.text: I absolutely love Oak Cliff Pilates. I go multiple times a day, and often with friends because I love so many of the instructors and different flows. Allison, Brianna, Caitlin, Cory, Cossette, Pepe, Tracy and Z are some of my favorites. It’s a great community feeling and a good way to make new friends while working out your mind and body. I highly recommend this studio. While I personally primarily go for the Bishop Arts location, I’ve hear wonderful things about all three!

reviews.author: Louise Atadja
reviews.text: Excellent class with Pepe! Thoroughly enjoyed and definitely felt it! Very spicy - the good kind!

reviews.author: Nidia Zozaya
reviews.text: Melissa at the Uptown location was an incredible instructor. Her class was very beginner friendly and she was very observant, especially with any beginners taking her class! We took her ‘Classical AF’ class and it was perfect! Thank you Melissa :) Parking was also super easy. We had a 630p and 730p class. The parking in front of the studio was full so we parked in the garage and there was only a few cars. be sure to validate your parking at the front desk :)

reviews.author: Jessica McNally
reviews.text: Melissa was absolutely amazing! very attentive and encouraging for this being my first class and the class was challenging, yet attainable for a first timer. signed up for the 3 classes for $25 but already know I’m signing up for the monthly classes :)

reviews.author: Shan Fisher
reviews.text: Absolutely love taking Pilates with Jesika! She’s motivating, attentive, and explains every movement so clearly. I’ve gotten stronger since starting her classes. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Stephanie Cooper
reviews.text: This is one of the best if not the best Pilates class I’ve taken (and I do Pilates everyday). Zenia is AMAZING. The class was challenging but that’s what I’m there for. The music, her energy, a few jokes - all 100/10. Highly recommended, will return!

reviews.author: Christina Troia
reviews.text: If you haven’t taken a class with, Tracy, you are going to want to sign up asap! Not only are her classes incredible with a seamless flow, but she is also so encouraging and keeps you motivated the whole way through!

reviews.author: Allie P.
reviews.text: Amazing class, the instructor challenged us and got to try things I’ve never done in my many years of reformer classes! The space is beautiful and while the windows must be great in the sun light, it was a little uncomfortable during the evening class since there were lots of people walking outside.

reviews.author: Edeline D.
reviews.text: Took classes here several times in 2025 while traveling to Dallas for work and I thoroughly enjoyed them. The instructors are great and the classes are challenging while being easy to follow along. The cues are helpful and the instructors do well correcting form as needed. I highly recommend this studio.

reviews.author: Elisa Balderas
reviews.text: Loved it!! Staff is amazing

reviews.author: Dylan Lopez
reviews.text: Verandah, Hisako, & Tracy always bring the heat and make it fun!!!

reviews.author: Ronnisha Wilder
reviews.text: I had an amazing time in my Og reformer class it was awesome and Cory was a great instructor as it was my first time in the studio. Excited to attend more classes!

reviews.author: Shawn Curran
reviews.text: Hands down the best Pilates studio I’v ever been too. The vibe, atmosphere and people are like no other. The memberships are good priced and instructors are awesome! I especially like taking Amanda’s classes because they kick my butt. You will not be disappointed! 10/10 highly recommend

reviews.author: Josalyn Wilson
reviews.text: Loooooove oak cliff Pilates! Been coming for a year now and it’s the best! Cory, Charlie, Nikita, and Pepe are so sweet and will have you feeling the burn for sure. All 3 locations are fun and bring the vibes. 😎🫶🏻

reviews.author: Juliana Steward
reviews.text: Maritza C was awesome, thorough and very motivating and I loved the Classical AF class. Will be coming back!

reviews.author: Michael J. Rhima
reviews.text: Thanks Amanda & OCP for an amazing work out!

reviews.author: Mai Trabue
reviews.text:
I truly appreciate the positivity at Oak Cliff Pilates. I’ll be honest, I’m definitely not on the same level as some of the more advanced people in class, but the way the instructors give encouragement, positive feedback, and motivation makes such a difference. There’s absolutely no judgment, everyone is doing the movements in their own way, and that makes it feel like a really safe and welcoming space to learn.

It’s so nice to walk into class knowing I’m supported, not judged, and that I’m there for my progress. This studio is great for anyone who genuinely wants to build strength and learn proper form at their own pace. I’m really looking forward to continuing my journey here, getting stronger, and improving over time.

reviews.author: Alaina Boone
reviews.text: Me and my friend have been to this studio numerous times and we’ve absolutely adored the classes every time. We’ve had 4 different instructors and each of them have their own unique teaching styles and are so incredibly sweet. The studio is always well maintained and provides a welcoming environment for pros and beginners alike. Id HIGHLY recommend this studio if you’re looking into starting pilates!

reviews.author: Markee
reviews.text: I had a Pilates class this Saturday with Allison and it was great! She was very thorough and taught it very well. This was my first time and I feel it was very strengthened.

reviews.author: Macey S.
reviews.text:
I found Oakcliff Pilates after taking privates for a few years! Their experience is unmatched, IMO in Dallas. I love their Uptown, location and now a new location in Lower Greenville. The studio stood out to me for many reasons. 1. The instructors… Especially Charley Carroll 2. Convenience and locations. 3. For the most part, no waiting list on getting in. And, they have amazing specials if you’re looking to get started. $25 for three classes, so you can try out!
In comparison with the other studios, I have visited this is a 10 out of 10! They meet all my expectations, physically, timing with classes and financially! 🩷

reviews.author: Alexandria Butler
reviews.text: I have been doing Pilates about a year and a half now and this is the best Pilates Studio in DFW area hands down. My fav instructors are Nikita, Amanda, Z, and Tracy. They always have the best playlist and get you right in your workout. The results are unreal. Definitely 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.author: Courtney Chivers
reviews.text: Love this place! Started pilates in the mid summer and I’m obsessed. If you can book a class with Nikita. She pushes you but you’ll thank her for it in the end.

reviews.author: Ashley Cocklin
reviews.text: Love this studio! Nikita and Hisako are my favorite classes to take these days. The small group setting helps motivate me while also being small enough to ensure I’m not hurting myself (instructor attention).

reviews.author: Penny White
reviews.text: Yesterday, I had the absolute pleasure and great surprise to have a1:1 Pilates session. Barbara K was my instructor. She was absolutely great.  She helped me with instructions on improving my movements and positioning my body. It was a well spent 45 minutes and a great way to wind down my Sunday.

reviews.author: Cree Agent
reviews.text: This class was fantastic! Daisy is such an intentional and passionate instructor. She cares about the people that come in and it shows in the flow of the class. I get a great work out and I feel challenged yet still accomplished at the end of the session. I always feel comfortable and safe in the class and look forward to coming back each time! I love the staff and the collaborative energy in the classes that creates a fun community feel at Oak Cliff Pilates! ☺️

reviews.author: Brittney Bledsoe
reviews.text: Amazing experience for my first visit. I will be returning!

reviews.author: MacKenzie Kerkstra
reviews.text: Amazing class! The space is clean and the reformers were in great condition. Will absolutely be back. Probably one of the best classes I’ve found so far in Dallas!

reviews.author: Neomia Taylor
reviews.text: Amber did a really good job!!! I definitely recommend especially for beginners she is really good on explaining the exercises and the use of the equipment. Definitely going back

reviews.author: The Wellthy Life Coach FitN2MyLife
reviews.text: I love to mix things up for my physical wellbeing and have enjoyed the classes that I have taken so far. The location is convenient for me to get to, and the staff was very helpful and welcoming. I am looking forward to adding this location and workout option to my lifestyle routine.

reviews.author: Heidi G Torres
reviews.text: Allison Brando at the Bishop Arts location was amazing. She kept positive and encouraging energy throughout class and the flow was nice and challenging. Her cueing was spot on and she offered modifications/corrections which I highly appreciated. Take Allison Brando if you ever try OCP:)

reviews.author: Kelly Tripicchio
reviews.text:
Loved my experience for OG Pilates with Tracy. Great controlled movements that made the muscles shake and work hard but not completely sore the next day. Perfect 45 minute class just 4 minutes from me. I’ll be back!

And it’s so aesthetically pleasing and cute inside!

reviews.author: John Carr
reviews.text: My roommate and I decided to try Pilates for the very first time, and we had the greatest time!! Thanks to our instructor, Jessika, the process was so smooth, so much less daunting, and the experience overall was masterful. We will be back soon!

reviews.author: Maria Gardiner
reviews.text: Amazing class taught by Cosette!! Cannot wait to attend more classes from her, workout was the perfect balance of everything!!! Will definitely bring more people to her class!!

reviews.author: Madison S.
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this studio. I did my first class after seeing their special for newcomers (3 classes for 25). The workout was intense but the people are casual. No mean girl vibes here, and I saw all fitness levels. I thought the low volume of the music was going to bother me, but you’re working so hard you don’t even notice.

reviews.author: Braeden Ware
reviews.text: Took Allison B Classical AF class and LOVED it! Her cues were intentional and the class was at a deliciously slow pace finding the best burn. Will 100% be coming back

reviews.author: leslie rivas
reviews.text: I came late but the instructor was very welcoming.

reviews.author: Julia Ameringer
reviews.text: Great Instruction and a well-rounded workout. I went in the morning and the sunlight coming in from the large windows was really nice during the post-workout stretching. A great studio with great people!

reviews.author: Erin Collins
reviews.text: I took my first ever Pilates class here yesterday. I bought the new person special and can’t wait to go back. I took an experienced friend visiting from out of town and she said it was a great session. Everyone was friendly helpful and encouraging. Nothing to be scared of. Try it!!

reviews.author: jimmy flood
reviews.text: great studio!

reviews.author: holly thompson
reviews.text: Great class. Really well focused on core areas and getting the technique right.

reviews.author: Erin Brandao
reviews.text: Beautiful space with lots of light, just hard enough to make you feel it

reviews.author: Kendra Trevino
reviews.text: Loved the space and the instructor was so nice and welcoming.  Also all the props they have available is really exciting.

reviews.author: K Michaelis
reviews.text: The grand opening of this studio was awesome! It’s a very spacious and airy studio. I love all of the natural light that pours in. The location in the heart of Lower Greenville is perfect. Can’t wait to take some classes here!!

reviews.author: Toni Bergquist
reviews.text: Amazing Studio and Amanda is my favorite teacher! Can't wait to come back. Worth the drive from Bishop Arts (even though I love the B.A studio so much).

reviews.author: Laz R
reviews.text: Dani was amazing today! I took her OG Reformers class! She was extremely patient and kind! I love the style and pace of her class!

reviews.author: Laura German Do Nascimiento
reviews.text: I had a great experience at the pilates studio, the ambiance is great. The class made you work hard, the instructor Dani queued the movements perfectly and the music was at the perfect volume. I will definitely be coming back

reviews.author: Keirah Burrell
reviews.text: The new studio is absolutely beautiful! The aesthetic is very hip and clean. However, buyer beware, passersby can see directly into the studio. Hopefully they’ll get some frosting up soon for a little more privacy during our workouts.

reviews.author: Kimberlee Valadez
reviews.text: This studio is a gem! The instructors make everyone feel comfortable while still pushing you to do your best. Clean, modern, and uplifting—highly recommend.

reviews.author: sophie rose
reviews.text:
Cosette is one of the best Pilates instructors!!!
I've had the pleasure of training with Cosette for months, and I can confidently say they are one of the most knowledgeable and supportive Pilates instructors I’ve ever worked with. Their deep understanding of body mechanics, combined with a calm and motivating teaching style, makes every session both effective and enjoyable.
Cosette takes the time to tailor each class to individual needs, ensuring proper form and alignment while gently challenging you to push your limits. Whether you're a beginner or more advanced, they provide clear instructions and thoughtful corrections that help you improve with each session. Highly recommend Cosette to anyone looking to deepen their Pilates practice in a safe, supportive, and encouraging environment. - Audrey Marshall

reviews.author: K Michaelis
reviews.text: Great class and such a cute studio!! I took a Sunday morning class and it was not too crowded. They have a great deal that’s 3 classes for $25 which is a steal! Parking was easy at this studio, lots of spots right out front. So happy they opened up a Lower Greenville location too!

reviews.author: Alyssa Beasley
reviews.text: Had a 6:30 am class with Cory and she was amazing!! It was my first time so she showed me around and explained everything. During the session she made sure I was doing the workouts right and helped me to adjust my posture and movements. The best instructor I could have asked for my first time! Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Candice Johnson
reviews.text: I’m addicted. Everyone is so nice and attentive. I love that each person had their own unique experience.

reviews.author: Melany Silvera
reviews.text: Great class for beginners! I'm used to Solidcore which is more advanced, so this was more relaxing than a workout. But this would be fantastic as a starter class to reformer Pilates.

reviews.author: Cassandra Smith
reviews.text: Great class with Corey!  Very challenging and lots of modification for those of use who needed them:).  Second visit, may make this my studio!

reviews.author: EX- ponenT
reviews.text: had a truly delightful experience at this studio. The owners deserve a lot of credit for creating such an awesome, fitness-focused space. If you’re looking to improve yourself like never before, this is the place to be. Trust me, they won’t disappoint- Zealand Jared

reviews.author: Fashionably Wealthy with Bobbie Casalino-Lewis
reviews.text:
I was visiting Dallas recently from Los Angeles and sought out a Pilates studio. I could walk to from the hotel. Lucky me that the Uptown studio was less than a mile away.. I was greeted with great care by the owner. Amanda took her class and then a couple of days later took a class with Charley. Both classes were run very professionally and with great oversight which I needed. Thank you for a wonderful experience
Bobbie

reviews.author: Brian Gonzalez
reviews.text: Best studio I’ve been to because the owner is my mom

reviews.author: Aida Nasirian
reviews.text: Great studio with fun, engaging classes! They offer the best prices in town, and I highly recommend this place. :)

reviews.author: Crystal Mosley
reviews.text: It was my very first time and can not wait to return. It was very fun and the staff was so very nice and helpful.

reviews.author: Amy Richardson
reviews.text: This place is magic. I enjoyed my first Pilates class ever today! Corey was so supportive and helpful. The class was wonderful. I will be back!

reviews.author: Edward Fajardo
reviews.text: Cory is an incredible instructor. I am new to Pilates and her attention and focus on me not getting injured was phenomenal. Loved, will definitely be going to more

reviews.author: Ali Beharry
reviews.text: Always a good workout. Daisy Llams is the best.

reviews.author: Chelsey Long
reviews.text: Such a great Pilates studio and the instructor, Kimberly, is so amazing!

reviews.author: Kim Nguyen
reviews.text:
Very fun studio- welcoming teacher and environment. Cute for pictures too.  Reformer class was a mix of props such as hand weights, even some fun jumping action. Hisako was so sweet and you could tell really loves her profession.

I don’t think if you’re BRAND new to Pilates this is the place for you though- there are terms like climb a tree, neutral pelvis, feet in straps, that you should hopefully have had exposure to. Instructor helped to change foot bar and springs but if you have never done any reformer Pilates it is easy to get lost and there wasn’t really an intro to the machine.

reviews.author: Enrique Almanza
reviews.text: Oliver and Zach were such great Pilates instructors. They made me work every single muscle, I left the studio feeling tired but happy and accomplished. I highly recommend both instructors . OCP is the best Pilates in Dallas area!!

reviews.author: Nicole Bell
reviews.text: I love it! Instructors are great.

reviews.author: Aurelius GGs
reviews.text: Great instructor and vibes! Just enough challenge to be tough and enjoyable!

reviews.author: Sagal Badeh
reviews.text:
Nikita is amazing. Always patient with me. I always work up a sweat and have gotten better since starting pilates with her. She's an amazing instructor :D

I just want to say how amazing Oliver is. I'm really sad he won't be doing his Wednesday night classes. When I first started with him I was horrible but he really was patient, and helped me through it.

He is an amazing instructor, I'm bummed I won't be able to go to his morning classes cause of work 😫

reviews.author: Patricia Harter
reviews.text: Oliver Williams is the reason I started coming here. He's an amazing instructor with a GREAT vibe! I got back into fitness attending his fit in the park classes. Once I got strong enough doing those again I started coming in OCP.  I love the difficulty level and the pace of the classes.

reviews.author: rachael quinn
reviews.text: I started coming to OCP after having an injury requiring me to go to physical therapy. My PT recommended pilates to help me continue to recover and I have had an amazing experience at OCP! The instructors are very hands on and attentive, and really make an effort to get to know you and your needs! I love the OCP fam!

reviews.author: Brittney Johnson
reviews.text: Definitely enjoyed my class. The instructor was made me feel like I was part of the class and explained and modeled each move. It was my first time and I was a little anxious but it was eased as soon as introductions were made. Great workout. I feel like I worked muscles I didn’t know I had. I will be coming back.

reviews.author: Cristina Rodriguez
reviews.text: Love ending/starting my week with Hisako’s restorative pilates class. Chloé’s classes are also amazing and her corrections with my form have helped tremendously! All of the OCP instructors are incredible but Hisako & Chloe convinced me to finally get a monthly membership.<3

reviews.author: Kate McLeod
reviews.text: Oak Cliff Pilates has changed my life! I've been going since the very beginning, even before it became Oak Cliff Pilates. I can't recommend it enough! So many of my friends have joined over the years! Every instructor is amazing! So thankful for this studio!

reviews.author: Janna Robison
reviews.text: It's been 11 years since I've practiced Pilates.  This studio has made my return SO joyful, efficient, and impactful.  From the motivating instructors to the beautiful environment to the every-minute-counts workouts, I am hooked.  After only 3 weeks of diligent practice, I feel 10 years younger and as though I'm picking up right where I left off.  Thank you, Oak Cliff Pilates!!!

reviews.author: Hana Kaneshige
reviews.text: Best Pilates studio around! A great range of instructors, tons of different classes, and a very welcoming environment. Being able to access both studios (Oak Cliff + Uptown) with one membership is awesome.

reviews.author: Nicole Gutiérrez
reviews.text:
love! my favorite place ever!
Z is the best!! 10/10 🔥🔥🔥

reviews.author: Kiyana X
reviews.text:
I love Amanda’s class! She’s the best!
I just wish she had later classes after 6pm so I could use those after work or any class on the weekends.
I might look for another studio after my job starts in the summer.
Update: I tried out another instructor and loved it

reviews.author: Amber O'Laughlin
reviews.text: I love this place. Always such a great workout.

reviews.author: shelby hunter
reviews.text: Great experience at Oak Cliff. Had a great instructor. We had Cory Rojo. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Katrice Thompkins
reviews.text: Truly a great experience!! The instructor made me feel seen and comfortable!! Thank you I will be back!!!!

reviews.author: Madison Jensen
reviews.text: Was traveling for work and found OCP, incredible studio & class! Loved the Tabata, reformer combo! I’ll definitely be back the next time I am in Dallas! Thank you again!

reviews.author: Maria Mendoza
reviews.text: This is a very cute Pilates studio! Had a great time at the Pilates AF class and will definitely be coming back for their other classes

reviews.author: priscilla martinez
reviews.text: Nikita was amazing! This was my first time doing Pilates! I loved the class and will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Evelin Zelaya
reviews.text: I really enjoyed Pilates. Charley was amazing and helped me out a lot since it was my first time. I can’t wait to go back again.

reviews.author: Emily Johnson
reviews.text: Loveeee Nikitas class! Relaxing yet intense!

reviews.author: Amanda Lewis
reviews.text: Great facility, I was traveling and able to hop in a morning class.  Clean and friendly - good workout

reviews.author: Jennifer Sprague
reviews.text: Very friendly and helpful instructor for first timers.  Nice atmosphere.

reviews.author: suzan kearns
reviews.text: Great class w Cory & Charlie … first timer for Pilates .. they both made me feel comfortable .. although challenged!

reviews.author: Ebelin Aguilar
reviews.text: Cory was supper sweet! It was my first time going and she made it feel comfortable for me and guided the class very well! Such a judgment-free zone. :) recommend for anybody looking to try Pilates for their first time!

reviews.author: Veronica Manriquez
reviews.text: I purchased a 3-pack to try this new location. I tried three different instructors and three different class types and loving it so far. I'm so glad to finally have a workout location near my home. Highly recommend the Jumpboard class with Maritza...so much fun and a great workout!

reviews.author: Joyce Manalo
reviews.text: Love the high quality reformer and the setup. Everyone gets a good view of themselves in the mirror. Charley was very welcoming. His pilates session had us use the equipment in unique ways. I love feeling length & strength with each rep. It was what I needed after an intense yoga class.

reviews.author: Marisa Roberson
reviews.text: I initially signed up for the new client special just to try out and I had such a great time at OCP - Uptown with Instructor Ze! Ze is so motivational, fun and inspirational! The studio is intimate, comfortable, and stylish! I look forward to a lasting membership with OCP, highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Janelle Dickerson
reviews.text: Very clean studio and beginner friendly. I will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Rashawn Eugene
reviews.text:
Oh Reformer Pilates

Awesome and intense. I felt wonderful afterwards

reviews.author: Josefina Ghio
reviews.text: Cory was an amazing instructor, great class and workout!

reviews.author: Victoria Lennox
reviews.text: The BEST Pilates studio in town! I tried Pilates for the first time ever & it was better than I could’ve imagined. The instructors are so nice & welcoming. If you’re intimidated by trying out Pilates - go here and you won’t be! So happy I found OCP & their first-timer deal is unbeatable.

reviews.author: Ashley Cocklin
reviews.text: Attended my first Pilates class EVER with Hisako last night. It was great and I will be back! She was super friendly and taught me how to use the reformer with patience!
